instruction: Find all .jpg files located within the 'vacation' subdirectory and its subfolders in the photos directory, then copy them to a folder named 'vacationpics'.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires finding all .jpg files only from the vacation subdirectory (and its nested folders thailand and hk) and copying them to vacationpics. There are 3 .jpg files in vacation folders: monk252520thailand252520wat252520arun252520scaled25255B225255D.jpg in vacation/thailand/, hong-kong-china.jpg and hk_group_photo.jpg in vacation/hk/. The emnlp2023.jpg file is in events/ folder so should not be copied. Evaluator uses existing check_moved_jpgs metric. Verified: exactly 3 vacation .jpg files should be copied.

llm_judge_reasons: Evaluator correctly verifies all instruction requirements: (1) files are .jpg extension, (2) files are from vacation subdirectory and its subfolders, (3) files are copied to vacationpics folder
Getter (get_list_directory) correctly extracts directory state from target location /home/user/Desktop/vacationpics
Metric (check_moved_jpgs) correctly compares result against expected files using both count check and set equality, ensuring exact match

Expected values are semantically correct: includes exactly the 3 .jpg files from vacation/thailand and vacation/hk subdirectories, correctly excludes us_3.png (wrong extension) and emnlp2023.jpg (wrong location)
